items: Article 161 deals specifically with the Pardoning power.
Article 165 establishes the office of the Advocate General.
Article 213 grants the Ordinance making power at the state level.
Article 356 pertains to the emergency provision of President’s Rule.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 153, 155, and 156 govern the Governor's office, appointment, and term.
Article 161 defines the pardoning power of the Governor.
Articles 163, 164, and 165 detail the Council of Ministers, Ministers, and the Advocate General.
Article 213 gives the power to promulgate ordinances, while Article 356 deals with President’s Rule.
